_note: Checked 2026-11-15. Anthropic prices: official page fetched 2026-11-12 (docs/evidence/pricing-2026-11-12/). OpenAI and Gemini prices: official pages fetched 2026-11-15 (docs/evidence/pricing-2026-11-15/). VERIFIED there: the per-token rates below. NOT documented, so still ASSUMPTIONS: how many tokens gpt-image-2.5-sunburst counts per input (reference) image and per output image (OpenAI: 'use the response's usage to measure token consumption'). reserve_* fields are what each call holds before it is sent (neither API lets a caller cap image tokens); expect_* fields are only for the estimate; settled costs always use the usage each provider reports.

entries.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-image-2.5-sunburst ; https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-generation (GPT-Image-2.5: $8/M image input, $2 cached, $30/M image output, $5/M text input, $1.25 cached; text output not billed; standard processing). Token counts per image are not published for 2.5: reserve 7,000 per input image (above the only documented rule, gpt-image-1 high fidelity, at most about 6,563 for the app's image sizes) and 6,500 per output image; expect 628 output tokens (the docs' calculator formula at medium, largest size used, 1536x1536; the model page says that calculator does not estimate 2.5).
entries.verification: VERIFIED rates (official model page and image guide, fetched 2026-11-15). Tokens per input and output image are not published for this model: the reserve_*/expect_* values are assumptions.

entries.source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (paid tier: input $0.50/M text/image; output $3/M text and thinking, $60/M images; a 1K output image is 1,120 tokens = $0.067; Gemini 3 input images count 1,120 tokens at the default media resolution, docs/media-resolution)
entries.verification: VERIFIED (official pricing and media-resolution pages, fetched 2026-11-15). Thinking tokens are not capped by the API: 4,000 reserved.

entries.source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (paid tier: $0.75 input / $3.75 output incl. thinking per 1M tokens through 2026-12-31; $1.50 / $7.50 from 2027-01-01. The 2027 rate is used here, so estimates overstate cost by 2x until then). Input images: 1,120 tokens at the default media resolution (docs/media-resolution); the app reserves more (Anthropic's visual-token rule).
